gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.

gaps.explanation: 'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: The minister was ___ (CRITIC) for her handling of the flooding crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'Be criticised for' = be attacked verbally; the verb form is needed in the passive.

gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
